name: tonejs-music-production
description: Creates deterministic, mathematically optimized Tone.js music with digest-bound WAV proofs and release evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Compose, optimize, render, and prove coded music.
interface.longDescription: Turns symbolic compositions into deterministic integer-tick scores, renders them through Tone.Offline in Chromium, and binds per-track proofs, listening review, audio metrics, and release receipts to the source digest.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create a code-managed Tone.js music project, optimize its symbolic score, render it offline, and prepare verified WAV release evidence.
